feed.title: antxiko — commented disassemblies of 8-bit games
feed.subtitle: Old 8-bit binaries taken apart byte by byte and commented, with the tools to rebuild them: nothing gets claimed that the binary does not show, and the source has to give the original back, byte for byte. Right now that means 65 MSX games.

entry.title: Shalom: Knightmare III: a world of 512 rooms, nine bosses and the story, taken apart
entry.summary: Konami's 1987 MSX adventure, 100% explained and commented to 42.7%. The world and its dungeons, the 268 visible characters with their names, the nine action scenes with their bosses, the story in eight panels and the opening scene drawn from the ROM; the 902 Japanese texts and 42 tunes taken from the cartridge. Read in the code: a cloak that stops half the hits and a password that holds the whole game.

entry.title: Circus Charlie: the music, taken from its engine and checked against openMSX
entry.summary: 4 tunes of the cartridge, made by running its own sound engine frame by frame; the PSG writes match openMSX in every frame checked; the tunes had stalled on a value the game passes in a spare register.
